tools.name: task
tools.description:
Delegate work to a child session, or read and cancel a child this session started.

Spawn usage:
- Pass prompt with the full delegated task text; label is an optional short tag for the child.
- subagent_type runs the child under a builtin profile: execute, review, explore, research, or plan. The child's prompt becomes that profile's text plus your prompt, its tools become the profile's allowlist, and a read-only profile keeps the child read-only.
- tool_allowlist narrows the child's tools and can never widen your own scope; pass it without subagent_type.
- max_steps caps the child's steps (default 32).
- run_in_background=true (default) starts the child and returns its task_id immediately. false spawns and waits, returning the child's status and output in this same call.
- Depth, the chain's spawn budget, and your own tool scope always bound the child.

Control usage:
- operation="output" with task_id joins that child once and returns its status, output, error, and stop_cause. timeout bounds the wait in milliseconds (default 300000); status "running" means the child outlived it and is still working.
- operation="cancel" with task_id requests cancellation of a child this session started.

Scheduling a child and awaiting it with operation="output" is the whole control surface: there is no roster listing, steering, keep-alive, retry, or structured-output validation. Do not sleep, poll in a loop, or relaunch equivalent work.

prompt.description: Full delegated task prompt for the child session.

subagent_type.description: Optional builtin child profile; the child runs that profile's prompt text, tools, and read-only stance. Omit to inherit your own tool scope instead.

tool_allowlist.description: Optional tool names the child may use; never wider than your own scope.

max_steps.description: Step cap for the child session.

run_in_background.description: true returns the task_id immediately; false waits for the child to finish.

operation.description: output joins a child this session started; cancel requests its cancellation.

task_id.description: Child session id returned by a spawn.

timeout.description: Millisecond wait bound for a synchronous spawn or operation=output.

tools.name: task_batch
tools.description:
Dispatch bounded independent child work as one background group.

Usage:
- Pass tasks with 1-100 items. Every item requires prompt and accepts optional label, tool_allowlist, max_steps, and subagent_type (a builtin child profile: execute, review, explore, research, or plan).
- Every item is validated before anything is created; when all items are valid they all start in the background under one fresh group id.
- A result with partial=true lists the created and the failed items. Created children stay recorded and are never retried or cancelled automatically.
- Items must be independent: nested delegation, dependencies, keep-alive, and automatic whole-group cancellation are not supported.
- Read the group with operation="output" and parallel_group_id: each child is joined once and reported as a bounded per-child status, without prompts, transcripts, or child output.

Example: task_batch(tasks=[{"prompt":"Find the opening hours in the visitor guide"},{"prompt":"Summarize transport options from the visitor guide"}])

tasks.description: Independent child requests; all children start in the background under one fresh group.

prompt.description: Full delegated task prompt for this child session.

subagent_type.description: Optional builtin child profile; this child runs that profile's prompt text, tools, and read-only stance.

tool_allowlist.description: Optional tool names this child may use; never wider than your own scope.

max_steps.description: Step cap for this child session.

operation.description: output reads a group this session started instead of spawning one.

parallel_group_id.description: Group id returned by an earlier task_batch call.
